title: Attendance Record Credit in the Appointment Series Late-Cancellation Fee
content:
Decision table — attendance share in the late-cancellation fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The late-cancellation attendance share is 90 percent where the series shows at least 8 attended appointments, 95 percent where it shows at least 4 but fewer than 8 attended appointments, and 100 percent where it shows fewer than 4. The share is read as a percentage of the late-cancellation basis and multiplies it.

**Count used.** All attended appointments recorded on the series itself.

| Attended appointments on the series | Attendance share |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 90 percent |
| 4, 5, 6 or 7 | 95 percent |
| 0, 1, 2 or 3 | 100 percent |

**Boundary rows.** 8 attended appointments give 90 percent and 7 give 95 percent; 4 give 95 percent and 3 give 100 percent.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** A series showing 9 attended appointments, on a late-cancellation basis of USD 60.00: 90 percent of USD 60.00 is USD 54.00.
